comparisonGroup.rule: same class (condo), market segment (CCR) and lease-age group; original lease 99 years or longer

profile.rule: Each line compares this development with its own comparison group; numbers from different groups are not comparable. There is no overall score.
profile.surroundingMarket: Surrounding market: other condo and EC developments within 2 km (straight line between development positions); new sales plus resales; subsales, cluster and other landed housing, HDB flats and this development are excluded. Competition, the quiet-area check and the Market backdrop use this same set.

lines.label: Entry price against comparable developments

missing.reason: too few comparable resales for a price comparison

lines.statement: Not available: too few comparable resales for a price comparison.

lines.label: Sustained resale activity

missing.reason: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured

lines.statement: Not available: no recorded homes count for this development (URA count as at Q4 2022) or fewer than 30 homes, so a resale rate cannot be measured.

lines.label: MRT today
lines.statement: Great World MRT about 140 m, Somerset MRT about 580 m; closer than 508 of 551 similar developments (the same as 7). Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Primary schools
lines.statement: 1 within 1 km and 5 within 2 km; nearest River Valley Primary School about 270 m; more than 107 of 551 similar developments (the same as 202). Straight-line distances. MOE measures distance for school admission differently.

lines.label: Everyday amenities
lines.statement: 9 supermarkets within 1 km (nearest about 440 m), more than 419 of 551 similar developments (the same as 42); nearest hawker centre Zion Riverside Food Centre about 600 m; nearest park Istana Park about 980 m. Straight-line distances.

lines.label: Future transport
lines.statement: Not yet assessed: needs official LTA evidence for planned stations.

lines.label: Recorded new-launch competition
lines.statement: 8 other condo developments sold new homes within 2 km (River Green, 34 new sales, about 240 m; The Avenir, 1 new sales, about 330 m; River Modern, 431 new sales, about 360 m; Promenade Peak, 99 new sales, about 560 m; Hill House, 5 new sales, about 570 m; Zyon Grand, 637 new sales, about 660 m; Grange 1866, 6 new sales, about 740 m; The Robertson Opus, 40 new sales, about 900 m). Surrounding market, Oct 2025–Sep 2026: 345 other condo and EC developments within 2 km recorded 1,456 new sales and 1,204 resales (2,660 purchases); new sales were 54.7% of these purchases. Subsales (45) and this development’s own transactions are excluded. New sales as a share of local private purchases is a measure of market activity, not of supply pressure.

lines.label: Unsold inventory

missing.reason: not available until the URA-based launched-unsold measure (S3) passes the V1 local validation; no other inventory source is used

lines.statement: Not available: unsold inventory has not been validated.

lines.label: Known pipeline

missing.reason: known sites only; not a complete pipeline

lines.statement: Within 2 km: upcoming Sophia Meadow development, about 1,480 m; Peck Hay Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,640 m; Bukit Timah Road GLS site (government land sale site, awarded), about 1,880 m. Known sites only; not a complete pipeline.

lines.label: Quiet-area check
lines.statement: Not a quiet area. 1,204 resales within 2 km in Oct 2025–Sep 2026, more than 454 of 551 similar developments.

lines.label: Market backdrop
lines.statement: Condo and EC resales within 2 km: 1,204 in Oct 2025–Sep 2026 against 1,338 in Oct 2024–Sep 2025 (−10%). Planning-area private resales −3.8%. Observed transactions, not a prediction.
